func publishInvoiceEvent(httpClient *Client, region string, invoiceItem Event) {
    targetUrl := resolveEndpoint(region)
    bodyBytes := serializeJsonBody(invoiceItem)
    digestHex := formatPayloadDigest(bodyBytes)
    authToken := computeHmacSignature(digestHex, httpClient.signingSecret)
    statusCode := transmitHttpPost(httpClient, targetUrl, bodyBytes, authToken)
    recordTelemetryCounter(statusCode, region)
}

func publishRefundEvent(httpClient *Client, region string, refundItem Event) {

    bodyBytes := serializeJsonBody(refundItem)
    digestHex := formatPayloadDigest(bodyBytes)
    authToken := computeHmacSignature(digestHex, httpClient.signingSecret)
    statusCode := transmitHttpPost(httpClient, targetUrl, bodyBytes, authToken)
    recordTelemetryCounter(statusCode, region)
}
